---
engine: markdown
title: "Arrow IPC"
---

```{term}
#| include: false
rush run -o mtcars.csv 'mtcars'
```

Files ending in `.arrow`, `.ipc`, or `.feather` are read and written with
[arrow](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/r/). Arrow IPC (also known as Feather)
is a fast binary format for exchanging data between tools such as R, Python,
and DuckDB. Write it with `-O arrow` or an output file with one of these
extensions.

## Writing

```{term}
rush run -o fast.arrow 'dplyr::filter(df, hp > 200)' mtcars.csv
```

## Reading

```{term}
rush run 'dplyr::select(df, mpg, cyl, hp)' fast.arrow
```

The `.feather` and `.ipc` extensions work the same way:

```{term}
rush convert -o fast.feather fast.arrow
rush run 'nrow(df)' fast.feather
```

```{term}
#| include: false
rm -f mtcars.csv fast.arrow fast.feather
```
